videos.title: The S.K.I.L.L. Framework for Better AI Skills
videos.description:
What makes a good AI skill?

I created the S.K.I.L.L. framework to make AI skills easier to discover, follow, maintain and improve:

S — Scope: Give the skill one clear purpose.
K — Keywords: Include the words people and AI agents will use to find it.
I — Instructions: Provide actionable guidance, not a long background monologue.
L — Lean Body: Keep the core instructions focused and ideally under 500 lines. Move supporting details into resources when needed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
items.description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events.
